== History ==
The clan was formed on September [[2010]] to get some old rusty players into the game again. To get started we signed for [[EQL Season 12]].
However the clan was only meant to get rusty players back on track so before the next season (starting early 2011) the clan died. 
The better players went on to form [[WarPigs]] and the rest well, stayed rusty =)
